Yellow text overlays appear at the top. (2) The visual shifts to include screenshots of a social media platform (Threads) and mobile game interfaces (Artale) showing item stats like 'Wizard Shoes'. Gary holds his phone towards the camera, while Janie points at the screen. Variety-style captions with 'OMG' and 'Cringe' expressions appear rhythmically on screen until the final frame.

It leverages humorous storytelling about a staff member's gaming addiction to engage the community and drive downloads of the creator-made asset.
